instructions.name: accept_authority
docs: Step 2: the successor signs to accept, so a typo can't hand the
protocol to a key nobody holds.

instructions.name: auto_deleverage
docs: Auto-deleverage a profitable position once the market's budget is spent.
Keepers rank by unrealised PnL off-chain and close the most profitable first.

instructions.name: cancel_order
docs: Owner can reclaim escrowed collateral from an order no keeper filled.

instructions.name: cancel_withdrawal
docs: Puts a pending request's shares back in the LP account.

instructions.name: claim_creator_fees
docs: Pays the creator `creator_fees` (the early 20%) at any time, plus
`creator_fees_locked` once the market's curve has graduated.

accounts.name: curve
docs: The market's launch curve; read for graduation. Appended last.

instructions.name: claim_protocol_fees
docs: Admin: pays accumulated protocol fees out to the treasury.

instructions.name: compound_protocol_fees
docs: Permissionless (the keeper runs it): turns ALL accrued protocol fees into
vault liquidity owned by the treasury's LP account (set_treasury),
at the vault's current share price. Nothing moves: the fees stop being
reserved and start backing trades. The treasury takes fees as cash by
claiming them first (claim_protocol_fees, admin only).

accounts.name: treasury_lp
docs: The treasury's LP account, whoever pays for the call.

instructions.name: crank_funding
docs: Permissionless crank: accrues funding and rolls the band anchor.

instructions.name: create_market
docs: Permissionless: opens a Tier 0 market for any Ringside curve.

instructions.name: deposit_to_treasury
docs: Anyone (the treasury sweep's hot key) deposits USDC whose shares go to
the treasury's LP account, never the depositor's.

instructions.name: execute_order
docs: Step 2: keeper fills an order at the delayed, banded TWAP mark.

instructions.name: forfeit_creator_fees
docs: Permissionless. Once the market's curve is `CREATOR_FEE_FORFEIT_SECONDS`
old and has not graduated, moves the market's locked creator fees into
`vault.protocol_fees` (compoundable into treasury LP shares). No USDC
moves and `vault.reserved` is unchanged: both buckets are part of it.

instructions.name: graduate_market
docs: Permissionless: once the token's curve has migrated to Raydium, move its
market to Tier 1. Prices then come from the pool's TWAP (remaining
accounts: pool state, observation, token vault, wSOL vault).

accounts.name: program_data
docs: This program's ProgramData account, which the upgradeable loader keeps at
the PDA of the program id and which names the upgrade authority. Only that
authority may initialize: whoever calls first becomes vault admin and
picks the USDC mint.

instructions.name: liquidate
docs: Permissionless liquidation of an under-margined position.

instructions.name: propose_authority
docs: Admin: who may push a SOL price by hand. On mainnet set this to a key
nobody holds, so only Pyth can move the price.
Admin handover, step 1: the current authority names its successor
(on mainnet, the Squads multisig vault). Nothing changes until step 2.

instructions.name: refresh_sol_price
docs: Permissionless: copies Pyth's SOL/USD into the vault after checking the
account owner, feed id, full verification, age (120 s, the vault's own limit) and confidence (2%).
Older prices than the stored one are ignored.

instructions.name: request_order
docs: Step 1 of a trade: escrow collateral and record the request.
A keeper fills it at the first mark at least FILL_DELAY_SLOTS later.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays rent for the order (refunded to it on fill or cancel) and, the
first time, for the position. The relayer signs here so a fresh trading
account needs no SOL. Can be the owner.

instructions.name: request_withdrawal
docs: Step 1 of a withdrawal: moves shares out of the LP account into a
request that unlocks after WITHDRAW_DELAY_SECONDS. The shares stay in
total_shares, so they keep sharing the vault's PnL until paid out.
Adding to an open request restarts its timer.

instructions.name: resize_market
docs: Permissionless migration helper: grows a `Market` created before
`creator_fees_locked` existed to the current size (the payer funds the
extra rent; new bytes are zero). No-op if already large enough.

accounts.name: market
docs: because an account too small for `Market` cannot be deserialized.

instructions.name: retire_market
docs: Permissionless: frees the Tier 0 slot of a dead launch. Allowed when the
curve hasn't sold out, hasn't traded for ~7 days and the market has no
open interest. The market becomes reduce-only (it can still graduate later).

instructions.name: set_market_limit
docs: Admin: how many Tier 0 markets may be live at once.

instructions.name: set_market_limits
docs: Admin: lower any market's OI cap (0 = no override) or make it reduce-only,
e.g. to keep perps off the protocol's own token. Takes effect on new
opens; existing positions can always close.

instructions.name: set_market_tier
docs: Admin: promote a graduated market to Tier 2 and optionally cap its OI.

instructions.name: set_sol_price
docs: Fallback price push by the price authority (devnet; disabled on mainnet
by setting the authority to an unheld key).

instructions.name: set_treasury
docs: Admin: names the treasury, the owner of protocol-owned LP shares. Set it
to the multisig vault, so withdrawing the treasury's liquidity needs a
multisig vote while deposits (below) can come from a hot key.

instructions.name: withdraw_liquidity
docs: Step 2: once unlocked, pays the request's shares at the vault's value now.

fields.name: price_cumulative
docs: TWAP accumulator: sum of price_q64 * slots, wrapping.

fields.name: creator_fees_locked
docs: The 80% of creator fees held until graduation. APPENDED after `bump`:
curves created before this field existed need `resize_curve`.

fields.name: trader_net_pnl
docs: Realised PnL paid to traders net of losses (positive = vault lost).

fields.name: creator_fees_locked
docs: Locked 80% of creator fees. APPENDED after `bump`: markets created
before this field existed need `resize_market`.

fields.name: pool
docs: The Raydium pool this market prices from, fixed once at `graduate_market`.
APPENDED after `creator_fees_locked` (`resize_market` grows older
markets). All zero = no stored pool: a Tier 0 market, or one that
graduated before this field existed, whose pool is Raydium's
canonical address for the mint (see `expected_pool`).

types.name: PendingAuthority
docs: A proposed admin handover, waiting for the successor to accept.

fields.name: reason
docs: 0 = close, 1 = liquidation, 2 = ADL

types.name: TreasuryConfig
docs: Who owns protocol-owned liquidity (set by the vault authority).

fields.name: trader_collateral
docs: USDC posted by traders (open positions and pending orders).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Protocol fees, creator fees and insurance not yet paid out.
